name: icm-ops
description: Skills that keep an ICM workspace honest: a ledger that scores the agent's advice, a verifier that checks its work, a maintenance run that keeps the files true.

plugins.name: icm-ops
plugins.description: icm-ledger, icm-verifier, icm-maintain — the operating layer for a workspace built with icm-architect or by hand from the ICM paper. Includes a mod that runs the checker after each write inside a workspace.

plugins.name: probe-first
plugins.description: A mod that flags an absolute asserted with nothing run to check it — the failure the ledger scores most often. Procedural, never factual; speaks to the agent, never blocks.

plugins.name: session-leases
plugins.description: A mod for several sessions on one machine: before a git push, a scheduled-task change, a computer-use action or a command named in the machine's lease config, it takes a lease for the session and refuses the call while another session holds one, naming the holder. Fails open.
